game.ODD_ONE_OUT.meta: Find the card that does not belong
game.round.label: Round {n} of {total}
game.match.how: Tap an item on the left, then tap what it goes with. Each round has more pairs.
game.match.nudge: Not that one. Take another look at {left} and try again.
game.sort.how: Drag an item into a basket, or tap an item and then a basket. With a keyboard, press Enter on an item, then 1 or 2 (or the arrow keys).
game.sort.miss: Not yet. {label} goes in {right}, because it does not match "{wrong}".
game.sort.dragging: Moving {label}. Drop it in a basket.
game.eq.how: Drag a tile into a slot, or tap a tile to fill the next empty slot. Tap a filled slot to pick up its tile, then tap another slot to swap. With a keyboard, press Enter on a slot, use the arrow keys, then Enter to drop.
game.eq.wrong: Not right yet: slot {slots}. Tiles in the same group can swap places.
game.eq.held: {label} picked up from slot {n}. Use the arrow keys to move it, then Enter to drop it.
game.eq.full: All slots are full. Drag a tile to swap, or press Check.
game.odd.how: Tap the card that does not belong with the other three.
game.odd.notThis: Not this one. {label} fits with the others. Try another card.
game.odd.found: Yes, {label} is the odd one out.
game.odd.hint: Hint: one card that fits was taken away.
